name: qa5 manuscript: phone: turned on its side with the caret in a section and back, typing each time: the caret stays in its section and every key lands; to the corkboard and back, the page is where it was, with no caret
why: Passes except as the first test in an Obsidian just started (1 of 4 runs, 2026-10-05): there the tap before the turn finds no section (the page is still moving as the sections above it are drawn), so there is no caret to keep. The “Measure loop restarted” warning it was listed for is gone.

name: qa6 store: UX: a comment in the binder note’s properties survives a move
why: A documented limitation (docs/file-format.md): a property write goes through Obsidian’s serializer, which rewrites the whole block and drops comments. Obsidian’s own Properties view does the same.

name: qa6 store: UX: longform: a comment in the index note’s properties survives a reorder
why: The same documented limitation: Obsidian’s serializer drops comments in the properties block.

name: BUG: qa6 writing: setting a status in a note whose properties are hand written (comments, flow lists, quotes, block text, dates, CRLF) changes only the status line
why: The same documented limitation: Obsidian’s serializer rewrites the whole properties block (comments dropped, flow lists and quoting normalised). The note’s text is untouched.
